def find_all_paths(graph, start, end):
    result = []
    def dfs(node, path):
        path.append(node)
        if node == end:
            result.append(path[:])
            path.pop()
            return
        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            dfs(neighbor, path)
        path.pop()
    dfs(start, [])
    return result
```

    s2 = set(l2)
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for item in l1:

def knapsack(weights, values, capacity):
    n = len(weights)
    # 一维dp数组，dp[j]表示容量为j时的最大价值
    dp = [0] * (capacity + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        # 倒序遍历容量，保证每个物品只选一次
        for j in range(capacity, weights[i] - 1, -1):
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j - weights[i]] + values[i])
    return dp[capacity]
```

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result[i] = result[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

        return nums
    n = len(nums)
    k = k % n
